statusLine.command: input=$(cat); MODEL=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); IN=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.total_input_tokens // 0'); OUT=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.total_output_tokens // 0'); TOTAL=$(($IN + $OUT)); MAX=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.context_window // 200000'); [ "$TOTAL" -gt 0 ] && CTX="Tokens: $(echo "scale=1; $TOTAL/1000" | bc)k" || CTX="Tokens: 0k"; BRANCH=$(git -c core.fileMode=false rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'no git'); echo -e "🤖 \033[34m${MODEL}\033[0m | 📊 \033[33m${CTX}\033[0m | 📁 \033[36m$(basename "$PWD")\033[0m | 🌿 \033[32m${BRANCH}\033[0m"; echo -e "\033[90m═══════════════════════════════════════\033[0m"
